data.one_liner: A virtual joystick widget for Flutter applications with high customization.
data.what_it_does: Provides interactive virtual joystick components (`Joystick` and `JoystickArea`) that allow users to drag a stick within a defined area and receive position updates via callbacks. Supports various direction modes, snapping features, and customizable base and stick widgets.
use_when: Building games that require directional controls.
Implementing custom touch-based navigation or movement pads in apps.
avoid_when: You need standard UI navigation components like buttons or sliders.
strengths: Highly flexible and customizable appearance for base and stick.
Supports multiple direction modes (all, vertical, horizontal, etc.).
Includes a snapping feature for circular and rectangular joysticks.
weaknesses: Limited to virtual joystick and directional input use cases.
